Complete conditional Standard Model benchmark

Supplying the renormalized chiral gauge action, its state, matched renormalized parameters, measured references and a neutrino-mass extension gives the conventional particle benchmark. Its masses, spins, charges
and conjugates below are conditional Standard Model inputs or assignments. They are separate from the OPH source calculations.
Independent Yukawa parameters are permitted. Exact Koide is not imposed on measured poles; source dynamics do not select these benchmark inputs.

Three neutrino mass eigenfields, distinct from the three flavor cards

νₑ, νμ, ντ = U × (ν₁, ν₂, ν₃). The extension specifies the mixing matrix U and symbolic masses m₁, m₂, m₃; no numerical individual masses are assigned here. Oscillations constrain mass-squared differences, while the absolute
scale and Dirac/Majorana choice require separate inputs.
Mass-eigenstate antiparticles are distinct in a Dirac extension; a Majorana extension has self-conjugate neutral fields. Neither choice is derived by the source dictionary.
Three constructive joins on specified sources
These are finite mathematical attachments. The conditional Standard Model benchmark supplies additional physical action, state and matching inputs.
Complete controller → full CAR
A supplied attenuator r retains all sixteen flags, including loss. The
complete C-duty inverse also realizes the prescribed positive family
matrix Y. For any Y > 0, the full-occupation pairing is real-linear and
has norm 2 tr(Y).
Specified cubic kinetic action + Gaussian reference gives E² = c²p² +
mⱼ² in its controlled free limit. All eight valleys and the 39 massless
internal spectators are retained.

svg.text: Quantum Higgs → same Gauss law
The finite quantum-Higgs rank-one vertex has norm 2 and commutes with
all twelve Gauss generators. Complete memory feedback admits the same
finite gauge/Higgs H₀, without dividing by the active duty probability.
This supplies a finite interacting Hamiltonian join. It supplies no
selected Higgs vacuum, interacting chiral continuum, charged pole,
lifetime or physical clock.

svg.text: Compact texture → localized fields
The declared opposite-winding texture has a four-state spatial band. Its
exact invariant CAR subalgebra admits the same current and Higgs
pairing; energy readout uses the paired quadratic ground.
At phase 0: four positive charged frequency groups m_light ± 1/256 and
m_heavy ± 1/256, each enclosed with error < 1/25000. Positive Nambu row
counts 8,8,4,4; static source-clock gap > 1/40000. These are additive
frequencies, not Dirac rest masses or GeV.

has zero held-out mass predictions.

No source-derived correction upper bound is available. A zero floor means the quoted windows admit the source ratios; it does not identify particles. Family-dependent kinetic or self-energy terms can respect gauge symmetry, while
their source origin and values require an independent calculation.
Why the two Koide constructions differ
For positive roots rⱼ = 1 + ρ cos(δ + 2πj/3), the exact quotient is Q = Σrⱼ²/(Σrⱼ)² = (1 + ρ²/2)/3.
Balanced coherent source
Y = C(z)²/3; ρ = √2 and Q = 2/3 in the positive-root chamber.
Default z = 1: action ratios 1 : 1 : (34 + 24√2) ≈ 1 : 1 : 67.94. The native default does not give three
unequal charged masses.
The comparison chooses θ ≈ 0.222222047073 from mu/e. The finite theorem does not derive this phase.
All original flags are retained. A generator frequency becomes physical energy only with a clock; repair
cost is not automatically a mass.
Conditional capacity response (MCPR)
χ = (u²/512)/(1 − u/77); ρ = √2 exp(−χ); δ = 2/9 + ζ(P,u). Thus Q < 2/3 for u > 0 and positive roots.
The complete C-duty inverse realizes gZ_C. Its positive-Y full-CAR lift is conditional. P₂,P₃,P₁₀ overlap;
they are not mass eigenprojectors.
512 = 2^(12−3) and 77 = (5+2)(12−1) are finite counts. Selecting these registers as the amplitude law and
choosing the 2/9 baseline are stipulated, target-informed inputs.
A distinct 16-flag attenuator realizes supplied r = exp(−χ), with every loss flag retained. The native
unread diffusion does not select this controller.
Exact native-memory diffusion is not the scalar damping ansatz

For H = R + R⁻¹ and J = i(R − R⁻¹), both [D(H),R] and [D(J),R] are nonzero in all four duties: always, C, E, CE. The complete 12×128 raw records and exact all-lag group inverse give this result at p=1/12, q=1/6, gain=1.
Scope: the unread h·G₁ coefficient at the fixed default rates. The complete dilation and controlled weak limit are retained; general self-energy maps are unproved.
What the discrepancy audit establishes
Exact arithmetic constrains the configured inputs. A valid finite theorem with an unmet physical premise remains valid; it does not establish the physical identification.
Rounding is not the mismatch
Independent 100-digit spectra lie inside the rational boxes. At fixed
inputs, P mu/e widths range from about 5×10⁻²³ to 3.3×10⁻¹⁴. Forward and
proxy residuals are about 1.8×10⁻⁵ and 1.5×10⁻⁵. Display rounding cannot
account for those differences.
Input ancestry is part of the claim
Forward and measured-endpoint coordinates are declared decimals; their
physical endpoint uncertainty is unspecified. Closure boxes certify
roots within chosen census and scale laws. Measured-alpha ancestry and
target-informed architecture prevent a prospective source-only claim.
Central values are estimates
Exact central agreement is not required. The balanced held-out tau lies
inside both quoted windows, so its offset alone requires no correction.
Interacting kinetic, self-energy, infrared/resonance and clock errors
are uncomputed. No known physical cause or joint significance is
claimed.

The lightest root is a near-cancellation: small amplitude or phase changes can move heavy/light ratios substantially. A common rescaling cannot repair a ratio. A protected charge labels a whole sector, not a unique excitation or
lifetime; unstable μ, τ, W and Z require resonance observables.
Exact obstructions and unproved physical attachments
Red statements exclude the written identification in its stated source. They do not exclude every action, quantum field theory or OPH realization.
Exact Koide on the same deformed masses
For χ > 0 and positive roots, Q = (1 + exp(−2χ))/3 < 2/3. The same three
coefficients cannot also obey exact balanced Koide. A changed response
operator requires its own map.
Literal defaults as observed charged ratios
Current-gated C gives 1 : 119.900581 : 896.516443. Coherent phase 0 gives 1
: 1 : (34 + 24√2). Neither directly matches the charged-lepton ratios under
one common unit. Unknown interactions are outside this exclusion.
One valley by deleting the other seven
The actual sine action has eight zeros of alternating winding. A valley
projector is not reducing under the admitted local gauge action. The
interacting chiral regulator and mirror treatment require additional
control.
Fixed quantum link as an identity background
The source link is nilpotent. Its state-vector distance from I is at least
(√5−1)/2; its expectation differs from 1 by at least 1/2. A nonzero mean
does not remove order-one bidirectional relative fluctuations.
Static defect frequency as a particle rest mass
The proved compact branches add Eⱼ ± m. They do not obey the homogeneous
Dirac square. Creating their CAR excitation does not create or move the
prescribed background winding; no autonomous defect dispersion is derived.
Pixel self-consistency selects χ
The two admitted scale laws retain strict self-maps after χ → χ + 10⁻¹⁴.
Each perturbed law has a nearby self-consistent root and a disjoint Q
interval. Uniqueness for one fixed law does not select that law. No
explicit-shift uniqueness or fitted root is claimed.
Amber: physical conditions not established by these finite attachments

species identity. The conditional Standard Model benchmark assumes its action, matched renormalized parameters and measured references independently.
Protected source objects, without forced species links
The eleven objects belong to specified source sectors. Topological winding, an internal charge and a mass eigenmode are distinct data. No bijection to the eighteen targets is derived.

g.text: FINITE-SOURCE CANDIDATE EVIDENCE
The source catalogue and the tests for a particle
The numerical comparisons above retain their declared action, calibration and mass conventions. The following source catalogue and complete
detector results use the candidate confirmation receipt. Neither table assigns a physical species or a source-derived GeV mass.
AN EXECUTABLE REPAIR AND OBSERVER CONSTRUCTION
Repair can move disagreement into memory
The reversible seam rule stores the removed exchange disagreement in a coherent record. A declared address reflection then makes that
information participate in a finite wave. This program has its own preparation, clock and optional detector operations. Its source records do not
identify a natural particle.
coherent record
reversible correction
coherent record
The seam agrees. The record holds
what changed. Reversing the
operation restores the input; no
information is erased.
Exchange parity here labels a coherent seam state. It does not establish fermionic spin or statistics.
Commit a classical outcome at every event
Measuring and replacing the record gives a dissipative pump. The
phase-addressed variant has a faithful finite reference and complex
tomography, but its coherence decays. Repeating it does not produce an
undamped wave.
Reuse coherent memory during propagation
The seam correction Q and address reflection R define the unitary step W =
QR. One first-event population agrees with the native rule; later coherent
histories have different probabilities. The reflection is a declared operation.
1 PREPARE
A reference made with the same W
One controlled walk creates success and failure
outputs. Keep both records; retry only within the
stated memory budget. The successful source
reference is faithful and stationary under W.
Success: 131/810 per attempt
2 PROPAGATE
Coherent records carry the wave
For 1,440 source-and-memory states, the exact
native discriminant is I − L/60. Its walk phases
satisfy cos ω = 1 − λ(L)/60. A wave tick counts
one W; it is not a second in SI units.
No damping under the declared unitary W
3 READ
An apparatus changes the
experiment
Optional quarter-turn probes and a register
detector separate real and imaginary
coherences. Every outcome is retained. The
history effects span 2,073,600 Hermitian
directions. Readout can disturb the state.
Complete finite tomography; no arbitrary-POVM claim
The stationary reference is a reduced walk-register state. Conditioning on retained preparation labels changes it. Modular flow is nontrivial on readable effects, but its
generator is not identified with the walk clock.
A LOOP CHANGES THE READOUT IN THE SAME FINITE GAUGE WALK
Carrier rotations → retained lift → transported state → detector
The controller derives 120 lifts from 60 proper
carrier rotations. A closed two-pulse word produces
Z = diag(I₃, −I₂). Its internal sign survives even
when the carrier orientation returns.
The finite holonomy theorem permits this cover. It does not
require a single-valued spin lift of every carrier rotation.
One declared Z link makes two triangular
loops nontrivial. Coupling the five-level
code to seam transport gives 7,200 states
with one unitary clock and their own
stationary preparation.
Internal labels +2 and −3 are conserved.
The loop changes the three-step return
amplitude. This is an actual finite detector
distinction on the coupled source.
Return-amplitude change: -1/6750
The five code states are not five species.
Two observers compare the same detector
A change of observer frame transports the state, links and detector together. The executed detector then agrees: probability 1/60. Keeping the old detector
gives 1/120 and describes a different experiment. This proves agreement for the accepted finite chart operations; it does not certify every possible
observer response.

g.text: A SEPARATE FINITE LINK-MEMORY CONTROL
Boundary links held fixed
Interior links can move the flux
Odd regional flux cannot repair to vacuum
A declared 30-bit link register stores central signs on the carrier. The product of face signs inside a region
equals its boundary sign. If that boundary is fixed and odd, no allowed interior repair can erase every
defect.
The exact local program transports one defect to all 5 region faces: 20 checked moves and 30 retained holds.
Changing the boundary can erase the pair. This control has its own link-update clock. The joint program below
couples the defect and wave in one declared evolution.

g.text: Physical boundary. The wave experiment’s link background is supplied and static. Its flux cannot be removed by a gauge rechart, but an allowed link change can
erase it. Conserved internal charge is not a protected particle or a measured electric charge. No dynamical gauge backreaction, interacting 3+1-dimensional limit,
physical spin or source-derived GeV mass follows from this static-link construction.

g.text: A JOINT FINITE SOURCE: ONE PROTECTED REGION AND ONE WAVE
Defects and waves change one another
The joint program retains the link memory in the wave’s quantum state. The links change the wave step; the wave’s port controls permitted defect
moves. Both happen in one fixed reversible tick on 72,000 basis states. No moved-or-held outcome is measured during idle propagation.

A reference and a gauge constraint for this same clock

the reduced joint source; the full record archive is not claimed stationary.

A fixed background with visible
excitations
Uniform link and wave amplitudes form a pure

outcome.

CELL → NEIGHBOR → DETECTOR
Connected propagation with a
finite cone
Place cells on a declared cubic grid. A partial
exchange carries wave information to a neighbor
while keeping its link memory local and
preserving its constraint. The arriving wave
changes the neighbor’s defect motion. A finite
cone bounds influence.

ONE WAVE → SEVERAL OCCUPATIONS
Several waves share the same
links
The occupation extension uses antisymmetric
wave states and one shared defect register. Its
one-wave sector is exactly the original program.
Two-wave records are computed. Fermionic
hopping and tensor-wave exchange are distinct
spatial laws.

WHOLE FIELD → MOMENTUM RECORD
Three spatial directions, one
clock
The cubic experiment translates each whole cell:
its wave and retained link data. It records
momentum and clock interference together, with
every alternative kept. The larger cube adds
complex translation phases; its complete
probabilities are computed without materializing
every branch vector. Preparation failures count
too.
32 records; 256 on the larger cube
ONE EXPLICIT POSITIVE ENERGY LAW
Exact energies; a failed
relativistic test
The declared positive clock has exact carrier
energies and three-dimensional dispersion. Its
three populated positive gaps have the ratios
below. Their curvatures imply different limiting
speeds; refining this additive branch does not
give a common relativistic mass shell. These are
source energies, not lepton masses.
TWO WAVES → THREE DETECTOR OUTCOMES
An exact finite collision
Six actual source states form an invariant
interacting sector of the same positive clock.
From the specified pair preparation, two waves
exchange occupation between cells. The
detector keeps zero, one and two waves on the
left. The source contact term changes this
response compared with independent waves.
The carrier flux stays in its cell.
Maximum double occupation: π²/(π² + 16)
BOUNDARY DATA TRAVEL WITH THE DEFECT
The protected pair really changes cell
The enlarged link domain includes a flat vacuum. An interface gate carries
the interior flux and its exterior compensator together. Complete position
records give equal left/right chances after one exchange and certain transfer
after two. The moved link changes the receiver’s wave response. Five
internal face locations describe one protected type, not five identified species.
inside + outside

SAME SOURCE OBJECT → FREE DIRAC WINDOW
A rest frequency for that same flux pair
Two routing lanes carry the literal paired-flux link code. Their local memory
has 121 states, including collisions. A chosen mass coin uses the actual
count of 2 flipped faces. The same object’s position and Fourier readouts
have a controlled free Dirac limit. Its spinor memory and coupling law are
declared architecture.
ω² = |p|² + 4; |ω(0)| = 2 (declared units)
Bounded-window error: t·a·(3P² + 6P). No GeV or Standard Model identity follows.
A COMPLETE GRADED SOURCE
Positive particles and holes
A separate declared local law retains all
occupations of 20 graded flux slots per cell. Fill
its negative-energy bands to obtain the
lowest-energy reference. Adding an object or
removing one costs positive energy; the missing
object is a hole. Their free Dirac limit is
controlled. The native gauge currents act trivially
on these bare flux objects.
Free rest energy 2; neutral-pair threshold 4
ACTUAL SOURCE CURRENTS

cube label alone is insufficient.
4 · Species and interactions
Test current vertices, distinct flavors or polarizations, conjugates and allowed
decays. Retain competing modes.
5 · The right mass
Use a charged threshold, unstable resonance or specified renormalized mass.
Bound volume, cutoff and numerical errors.
6 · Independent comparison
Choose one common energy unit and compare complete predictions with
experimental errors and declared calibration ancestry.

a.text: The exact tests for every lepton, quark, gauge boson and Higgs candidate ↗

g.text: WHICH APPEARS FIRST?
A catalogue is not a cosmological birth order
The hot early Universe supports a temperature-dependent comparison: quarks and gluons at sufficiently high temperature; photons, electrons,
positrons, neutrinos and nucleons around nucleosynthesis. That does not identify the very first particles or an order of source defects.
Selected source state: ρ = g(H), so [ρ, H] = 0
A fixed one-time source effect has time-independent expectation in this preparation. Conditional apparatus histories can change. A physical early-Universe history
needs an initial preparation, production and cooling dynamics, and a map to observer time. The capacity/refinement index is not that clock; a first click is not a
particle birth.
